description: This file defines SplashActivity, an Android activity responsible for displaying a splash screen at app launch. It uses the Android 12+ SplashScreen API with a fallback for older versions, manages a 3-second display duration, and navigates to MainActivity afterward.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows a splash screen for 3 seconds and then navigates to MainActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the splash screen, manages splash duration using different methods for Android 12+ and earlier versions.

methods.name: navigateToMain
methods.description: Starts MainActivity and finishes SplashActivity after splash duration.
